correctness.rationale: For perfect evolution algebras (invertible structure matrix), the independent squares e_i^2 force all derivations diagonal; support edges i→j impose d_j=2d_i. When p=2 all vanish. In odd characteristic, a connected nonzero component admits h=ord_p(2) uniquely determined cyclic vertex colors up to h rotations; invertibility forces equal class sizes and h invertible intercolor blocks. The multivariate exponential formula for connected colored components yields F_q(z)G_{q,h}(z)^{(u-1)/h}, and disjoint h-cycles establish exact 0..floor(n/h) spectrum and first-window count. Direct integer check for GL4(F3) gives 24,261,120=24,253,200+7,872+48; the formal-series checker source has been read, but finite checks do not replace the exponential-formula proof.
